subject: Bulk compliance add-ons — pricing & residency options
messages:
From: Eva Lopez <procurement@healthsync.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@healthsync.com>, Legal <legal@healthsync.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Bulk compliance add-ons pricing inquiry

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security and platform teams dug into Redwood's compliance add-on options and we've got a follow-up pricing question before we take this to our procurement committee.

High level ask: we need pricing that covers audit logging retention (7 years preferred), KMS/HSM for key management, and US-only data residency (us-east). Two pricing patterns we'd like to evaluate:
- Seat-based (admins/users with audit access) + per-100k-event ingestion for audit logs
- Or a flat bundle with an annual retention tier and a fixed per-month capacity (preferred for budgeting)

We are targeting a 12–24 month committed contract and are interested in a meaningful credit/discount for committing to a year and consolidating multiple services (audit logs + KMS + residency). Rough scale: 300M audit events/month, 25 named admin seats, and two HSM nodes.

Please send a draft price matrix and any standard SOW language for residency & HSM procurement we can share with legal. Also note any onboarding credits or one-time migration allowances you can provide.

Best,
Eva
Eva Lopez
Procurement Manager, HealthSync Inc.
procurement@healthsync.com

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Bulk compliance add-ons pricing inquiry

Eva —

Thanks for the clear requirements. I've sketched a pragmatic option set below to make it easier for your procurement committee to compare. I'm attaching a short pricing PDF and a draft SOW with residency clauses.

Option A (Tiered bundle, recommended for budgeting):
- Audit logging (7yr retention): $8,500/month baseline (up to 50M events) + $0.60 per additional 100k events.
- KMS/HSM (managed, 2 HSM nodes): $12,000/month (includes rotation, key escrow ops).
- Data residency (us-east private tenancy): $4,000/month.
- Admin seats: $45/seat/month (25 seats = $1,125/month).
- Annual commit discount: 15% off bundle if you sign a 12-month commit; 20% for 24-month commit.
- One-time onboarding/migration credit: $25k (applied to first invoice) for contracts signed by 2026-12-15.

Option B (Seat + event pricing, flexible month-to-month):
- Audit events: $0.75 per 100k events, no long-term retention warranty (retained 90 days by default; longer retention add-on at $0.50/100k/month).
- KMS/HSM: same as above but billed per-use for HSM attestations.

Notes/constraints:
- HSM procurement lead time: 6–8 weeks for hardware staging and FIPS attestation in a private tenancy.
- Long-retention storage for 7 years will use cold storage snapshots; we include retrieval SLAs in the SOW.
- The 15%/20% discounts assume a minimum annual committed ARR threshold ($200k ARR for 12mo).

Next steps: if you want us to model a precise quote against your 300M event/month profile, I can run that with finance and drop a line-item quote. Alternatively, we can set a 30-minute pricing call tomorrow to walk through tradeoffs.

Attachments: Redwood_Compliance_Addons_Pricing_v3.pdf, HealthSync_SOW_Draft.docx

Thanks — look forward to aligning.

— Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Bulk compliance add-ons pricing inquiry

Karthik / Sean —

Quick internal note on the pricing draft you sent: 15% for 12 months is within our standard authorization for AE-level approvals, but the $25k onboarding credit bumps the effective concession too far unless we secure the $200k ARR floor strictly. A couple of suggested guardrails:
- Make the $25k onboarding credit contingent on a signed 12-month SOW with the $200k ARR minimum; otherwise reduce to $10k.
- For 300M events/month, we should model the per-100k event line as a blended rate — finance prefers a capped egress band (e.g., $0.50/100k for first 500M, then $0.35 thereafter) to protect margin.
- Approve the 15% (12mo) / 20% (24mo) matrix but add an expiration date (2026-12-15) and require initial payment within 30 days of execution.

If you want, I can sign off on the conditioned credits and expiration; otherwise loop in Sales Ops for an exception.

Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

(Internal)

Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Bulk compliance add-ons pricing inquiry — updated proposal

Eva —

Following internal review, please find a concise, procurement-friendly offer below (also attached). Key commercial points are highlighted so your committee can sign off quickly.

Summary offer (12-month commit):
- Bundle price (audit logs + KMS/HSM + residency + seats): $23,500/month (covers baseline up to 50M events)
- Additional events: blended $0.50 per 100k events up to 500M; $0.35 per 100k thereafter.
- Admin seats: included up to 25 seats.
- HSM: managed (2 nodes) included in bundle.
- One-time onboarding credit: $25,000 applied to first invoice if ARR >= $200k and contract executed by 2026-12-15; otherwise onboarding credit = $10,000.
- 15% discount applied to bundle for 12-month commit (reflected in the monthly numeric above).
- Payment terms: Net 30. Initial invoice due within 30 days of execution.

Operational notes:
- Residency: we will provision a dedicated us-east tenancy; estimated provisioning ETA: 6–8 weeks post-signature.
- HSM procurement: includes FIPS-certified keys and rotation schedule; customer is responsible for any third-party HSM licensing if required by their procurement.
- Audit retrieval & retention: 7-year retention delivered via cold snapshots; retrieval SLA is 48 hours for archived pulls (terms in SOW).

Action items:
1) If acceptable, please confirm and we'll push a DocuSign SOW to Ben/legal.
2) If you want a modeled line-item quote against 300M events/month, tell me and I'll attach the detailed spreadsheet.

I've attached the redlined SOW and the concise price matrix: Redwood_Compliance_Addons_Pricing_v3.pdf, HealthSync_SOW_Draft.docx

— Karthik
